sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that since the petitioner was not amenable for divorce as demanded by the defacto complainant, a false complaint was registered against him.

But,
the prosecution allegations are to be effect that, the petitioner used to harass her mentally as well as physically, and on 23/11/2023, he had beaten up her with a stick.

Since, the dispute is between husband and wife, if the petitioner is sent to jail, it may foreclose, the chances of settlement, if any,
in future also.

So, this Court is inclined to allow this petition, but on stringent conditions:-
(i) Petitioner shall surrender before the Investigating Officer on 24/1/2024 at 10.00am and subject himself for interrogation.

(ii) In event of arrest, petitioner shall be released on bail on executing bond for Rs.50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand only), with two solvent sureties each for the like sum to the satisfaction of the arresting officer.
(iii) Petitioner shall appear before the Investigating Officer, as and when, directed.
(iv) Petitioner shall not go to the house, where the defacto complainant is now residing, and shall not influence or intimidate her either directly or indirectly.
(v) Petitioner shall not influence or intimidate the witnesses or tamper with the evidence.
(vi) Petitioner shall not commit any offence, while on bail.
In case of violation of the bail conditions, the trial court is empowered to cancel the bail, in accordance with law.

Sd/-
SOPHY THOMAS JUDGE ska APPENDIX OF BAIL APPL. 11078/2023 PETITIONER ANNEXURES Annexure 1 TRUE COPY OF THE F.I.R. NO.769/2023 IN CRIME NO.769/2023 OF VALLIKUNNAM POLICE STATION, ALAPPUZHA DISTRICT DATED 24.11.2023
